name: Jeeter | 1.3g Infused Cannon | Triple Double
description:
Introducing the Cannon Live Resin Joint. Each joint includes one 1.3g Cannon. What sets Cannons apart is their premium flower combined with 100% live resin, delivering a full spectrum high terpene extract made from fresh frozen flower.
- Premium Flower
- 1 Cannon Totaling 1.3 Grams
- 100% Live Resin Made From Fresh Frozen Flower
